FM1_LORE_OVERLOAD.name: Late-Show Lore Bleed
FM1_LORE_OVERLOAD.description: High cliffhanger score but relies heavily on intricate late-season character lore that baffles a first-time viewer on TikTok.
FM1_LORE_OVERLOAD.mitigation: Editor should restrict Tier-1 ad spend to Episodes 1-10, or add a 2-second on-screen context card.

FM2_PACING_LAG.name: Vertical Pacing Lag
FM2_PACING_LAG.description: Clip duration is > 35s with sparse dialogue (< 3 lines), relying on atmospheric staring that scrollers swipe away from.
FM2_PACING_LAG.mitigation: Editor should trim internal silent reaction shots to compress duration down to 20-25s.

FM3_SUBTLE_HOOK.name: Subtle Opening Setup
FM3_SUBTLE_HOOK.description: Clip begins with polite or ambiguous setup lines before the explosive conflict hits 6 seconds in (missing the 3-second hook window).
FM3_SUBTLE_HOOK.mitigation: Snip the opening 3 seconds so the video begins directly on the provocative rebuttal or slap.

FM4_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH.name: Physical vs Lexical Disconnect
FM4_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH.description: Dramatic text description (e.g. 'cold gaze') that does not translate to visceral visual shock without specialized camera work.
FM4_SEMANTIC_MISMATCH.mitigation: Review storyboard/video rough cut to ensure actor expression carries sufficient kinetic energy.
